'''The Devouring''' was a campaign of [[Speciecide|extermination]] against the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] colonies of the Kiirium Reaches by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].

After the [[Xim Wars]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], the Hutts raided the Kiirium Reaches bordering [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] for [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], but otherwise left the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] alone. This changed when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] blazed the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and encountered the Tionese. The Hutts feared that the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] would unite and overrun them, and decided to take preemptive action. They attacked the worlds of the Kiirium Worlds and wiped out every last man, woman, and child they encountered. The Hutts destroyed the colonies, irradiating the worlds and erasing their histories. They destroyed or towed away the [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|Hyperspace beacons]] that Xim had built, leaving only the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Warrior's Trace]] as a possible invasion corridor to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].

The Kiirium Reaches were completely depopulated by the invasion, reduced to barren, radioactive worlds with very few [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] in the region. Over time, they became known as the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]].

The Tionese later remembered, in a largely garbled form, the Devouring as a winter religious holiday, with different traditions on various worlds. Some traditions, such as those of [[Stalimur]], had a night of silent confession and burning candles to ward away evil spirits, while others, such as the [[Wakemeet]] festival on the planet [[Barseg]], had children dress up as evil spirits, and would receive candy from their elders in exchange for a [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] blessing.

The destruction of the Kiirium Reaches was so comprehensive that knowledge of their very location was lost for millennia. Indeed, until the time of the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Ximology|Ximologists]] had not connected the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] to the Devouring, and instead believed that some kind of astronomical event like a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] had been the cause of the devastation there (though evidence of such an event had never been found). The expeditions of [[Bleys Harand]] and [[Henrietya Antilles]] largely solved the puzzle of the Ash Worlds, with discoveries such as the [[Antilles Map]] conclusively identifying devastated worlds in the region with the lost thrones of [[Xim's empire]].
